name: Acupuncturist

pf.license.need: always where the state licenses acupuncture: each acupuncturist holds their own active license from the state's board, under the title that state uses; a few states issue none (a switch from the state form)
pf.license.noLicense: where the state issues no acupuncture license: the business registration only, where the state asks; each acupuncturist's national board certificate kept on file as the business's own word, never shown as checked (Rosie's rule)
pf.license.who: each person; the business too where the state's form registers acupuncture clinics or their owners
pf.license.ask: each acupuncturist's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the business's registration number from the owner, where the state asks
pf.license.check: each number on the state board's official lookup; a person on Rosie's team checks within 1 business day when the lookup can't be read; the national board certificate and a clean-needle course record are kept on file as the business's own word
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.herbs: herbal consults only for a person with the herbal training or certificate the state's form asks for (a switch); the example: herbal consults wait for Noah's certificate
pf.license.away: home visits only where the state's rules allow acupuncture away from a clinic (a switch); the license covers the place where the patient is seen
pf.license.agreement: a health privacy agreement (a HIPAA business associate agreement) signed on the secure page before the first booking; every booking is handled as health information, cash-pay clinics included
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: malpractice insurance on file where the state's form asks for it

pf.services.shape: visits with one acupuncturist, each with a set length; at the clinic each visit also needs one of the treatment rooms; a new patient's first visit is longer (a health talk, then treatment); follow-ups after it; a treatment plan of weekly follow-ups is suggested in person, never pushed, and booked only with the patient's own yes
pf.services.examples: the example businesses' own prices (Lee Acupuncture Clinic and Lee Home Acupuncture), kept from Rosie's example numbers, not a standard; a plan pays its own fee, and the patient's share is an estimate

days and times that suit you

for a home visit: who meets the acupuncturist at the door, and a quiet room with space for the table
securePage: the plan's member ID and a photo of the card, or the claim number

pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child (the child's visit, with no needles); a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; a minor alone only where the state's rules let minors consent (a switch)
pf.questions.neverAsked: symptoms, reasons or results are never asked or typed in the AI chat; only a visit type from the list and the time pass through the AI

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, sudden weakness or numbness, a drooping face, or a sudden very bad headache
stop.say: This sounds like an emergency. Call 911 now. Don't wait for an acupuncture visit.

stop.words: a fall with a head injury, or someone who can't get up
stop.booking: no booking until they're safe; otherwise the safety steps come first, then the booking goes on

goOn.words: pain, stress or poor sleep with nothing else
goOn.what: matched to the business's own visit types; Rosie never judges how urgent it is, and gives no health advice
the safety step 'rest at home: the visit can move with no fee', then the booking goes on

pf.safety.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history, the health flags and the consent
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before a first visit (a same-day visit: before the time is held); one reminder
steps.who: every new patient; a returning patient's history stays on file a year, with a short health update before each visit
steps.result: not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (filled in on the secure page at the desk or the door, before any needles), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The acupuncturist reads the health answers
steps.when: after booking, before the visit (A7-x01, B7-x01)
steps.result: nothing stands out: the visit stays; a flag to talk over: the acupuncturist calls first and may change the treatment (no electro-acupuncture with a pacemaker; other points in pregnancy; acupressure with no needles at its own price); not right for acupuncture now: the acupuncturist calls and says who to see, then the visit is cancelled with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk or Sam, by hand
steps.who: every patient who names a plan or a claim
steps.result: covered, part covered, not covered (self-pay with the estimate notice), or can't check now (checked later; the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day (the example clinic's rule), or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk with its due date; one estimate can cover a series of follow-ups

steps.name: A doctor's referral or OK
steps.when: before the visit, where a plan or the state's rules ask for one (a switch)
steps.who: the business gets it, office to office
steps.result: not in by the due time: Sam calls; the visit moves with no fee, or goes ahead at the self-pay price with the patient's yes

steps.name: A reaction last time
steps.who: a patient who felt faint at an earlier visit
steps.result: the booking waits for the owner's OK; the reason stays in the record, never in a text

pf.first_steps.prep: wear loose clothes; eat a light meal first; finish the health update; at home: a quiet room with space for the table

pf.visit.checkIn: at the clinic: the check-in code at the front desk (where Sam sets a time with nobody at the desk, like Iris's Saturday mornings alone, the acupuncturist enters it); at home: the code at the door, from the patient or whoever lets the acupuncturist in
pf.visit.beforeWork: the acupuncturist goes over the health answers and how the patient feels today before any needles (a tongue and pulse check is a usual part), in the business's own chart
pf.visit.needles: single-use sterile needles only, counted in and out at every visit
pf.visit.changes: feels faint: the needles come out, the patient lies flat with water, gentle hands-on work instead, noted for next time; no needles wanted: cupping or acupressure at the agreed price; a fever or another sign the plug-in names: no needles that day; electro-acupuncture only when the acupuncturist decides, never with a pacemaker or other implant
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the treatment notes (points used, needle count, any reaction) stay in the business's own chart and on the secure page, never in a text
pf.visit.after: the acupuncturist checks how the patient feels before they get up; a treatment plan is suggested in person, never pushed, and booked only if the patient asks
pf.visit.away: a portable table and single-use needles; at home the patient is always there; no photos of the patient

pf.money.before: at the clinic: a card saved for the $20 fee (a late cancel or a missed visit; $40 for the first visit), nothing charged; nothing saved when a plan or a claim pays, or for a fee-free patient; at home: the $89 trip fee held for self-pay; a card saved where Sam sets a service to be charged at DONE; nothing taken when a plan or a claim pays
pf.money.after: at the clinic: paid at the front desk, the clinic's own way (a card, an HSA or FSA card, or cash); where Sam sets a time with nobody at the desk (the example: Iris's Saturday mornings), the saved card is charged at DONE, as the patient agreed at booking; at home: Rosie texts the bill, or the saved card is charged at DONE; a plan or a claim: the business bills it its own way
pf.money.plans: some health plans, the VA's community care, and work-injury or car-accident claims cover acupuncture; only the plan's name passes through the AI; the front desk or Sam checks the benefit by hand and records it; the patient's share is an estimate; a plan that won't pay this business turns into self-pay with the estimate notice
pf.money.selfPay: a self-pay patient is told while booking that they can get a written price estimate, and gets it on time; a bill far above it can be disputed (the federal rules set how)
pf.money.packages: a 5-visit package (the example clinic's own price, $160), sold only at the clinic, never in a booking text; a booking uses one of its visits; unused visits refunded on request (Rosie's rule)
pf.money.fees: the late-cancel or missed-visit fee: $20 at the example clinic ($40 for the first visit), up to the $89 trip fee at home; only when the owner confirms it; the same fee for every patient who may be charged one
pf.money.feeFree: a switch: no fee ever for patients whose plan or the state's rules bar one (like Medicaid, where that applies), or whom the owner marks fee-free; their texts say 'No fee to cancel or miss'
pf.money.receipts: a receipt with the codes a plan needs (a superbill), on the secure page, on request
pf.money.rosfield: the $2 per booking applies to this work, as to every kind of work (D97): a flat fee for each booking Rosie's AI makes, shown at sign-up for the owner's yes; a booking the business puts in itself carries no $2; card payments cost only Stripe's own card fee, paid to Stripe
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form (no deposits at the example businesses); fee limits for plan patients: from the plan's and the state's rules

pf.messages.never: texts to a patient carry only the business's name, the date, the time, the place, money lines and a secure link: never the visit type, the reason, the health answers or any result; a clinic text names no acupuncturist; a home visit keeps the acupuncturist's name for the door check
pf.messages.staff: texts to the owner and staff use the patient's initials, the time, the visit type from the list and a link; never a health detail (that's on the secure page: 'notes added')
pf.messages.healthTexts: a health question or update texted in is never answered by Rosie: it goes to the acupuncturist on the secure page, and the patient is told who will call
pf.messages.minors: a child's texts go to the parent or guardian

pf.staff.licenses: each acupuncturist's own license, per state, for the place where the patient is seen
pf.staff.skills: every acupuncturist: first visits, follow-ups, cupping and acupressure; child's visits only for those trained in them (the example: Iris); herbal consults only with the herbal certificate where the state's form asks (the example: Noah); home visits only for those Sam clears
pf.staff.supervision: none for a licensed acupuncturist; a student works only under supervision, where the state's rules allow it at all (a switch); none at the example businesses
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs same-day visits, a booking after a reaction last time, and anything the acupuncturist flags
pf.staff.standIn: another licensed acupuncturist may stand in, on a time the patient picks or OKs; the notes go with the booking on the secure side; only the acupuncturist decides what's safe
pf.staff.away: home visits: the acupuncturists Sam clears, each with a portable table

pf.rules.records: treatment records kept by the business for as long as the state's rules require; a delete request removes only Rosie's own booking details
pf.rules.copies: a patient's copy of their records within the time the rules set; Rosie sends only booking and payment records
pf.rules.showLicense: the license and the title shown where the state asks
pf.rules.minors: who may consent for a minor, and at what age a minor may consent alone (a switch from the state form)
pf.rules.referral: a doctor's referral or diagnosis first, only where a plan or the state's rules ask (a switch)
pf.rules.healthData: a separate yes for health answers on the secure page (Rosie's rule); any state's own health-data law comes from that state's form
pf.rules.packages: any state's rule for prepaid visits comes from the state's form; unused visits refunded on request (Rosie's rule)
pf.rules.ads: no claims of cures or results; a license is shown as the business gives it; Rosie doesn't check it; a national board certificate shows only as the business's own word
pf.rules.privacy: health privacy rules for every message and form

pf.edges.lateArrival: up to 15 minutes late: still seen, ending on time (a shorter treatment at the same price); later: moved with no fee, as the acupuncturist decides
pf.edges.healthChange: a health change before the visit (a new medicine, a pregnancy): Rosie never answers; the acupuncturist calls; the visit stays unless the patient moves or cancels it, with no fee
pf.edges.notRight: after reading the answers, the acupuncturist decides acupuncture isn't right now: calls first, says who to see, then the visit is cancelled with no fee
pf.edges.faint: feels faint at the visit: needles out, lie flat, water; noted for next time; the next booking waits for the owner's OK
pf.edges.forms: a form not done by its due date: one reminder, then Sam keeps the visit (filled in on the secure page at the desk or the door before any needles), moves it, or cancels with no fee
pf.edges.standIn: an acupuncturist out: a stand-in who does that visit, offered first, or new times with no fee; a child's visit stays with Iris
pf.edges.planChange: the plan check comes back not covered: self-pay with the estimate, or a free cancel
pf.edges.twoBookings: a patient with a series of follow-ups open: Rosie asks which one before any change
pf.edges.urgent: no visits sent now; a same-day visit for sudden pain gets the soonest time, once Sam OKs it
pf.edges.weather: none at the clinic; at home, a storm that stops travel: Sam moves the visit with no fee
pf.edges.children: a child is never left alone with the acupuncturist: a parent or guardian stays
pf.edges.needlestick: an acupuncturist's needlestick: the visit stops, Sam is told at once, and another acupuncturist finishes or the patient gets a new time with no fee

notes:
From: dentist (the clinic pilot). Why: acupuncture runs like the dentist's clinic, not like a chair: a new patient's first visit is longer, health questions are asked only on the secure page and read by the licensed person before the visit, plans and work-injury or car-accident claims sometimes pay, self-pay patients get a price-estimate notice, and no $2 is charged for a health practice. Its private-text rules and no-$2 sentences carry over; its care-home world, dental services and visit-priced and photo-priced paths don't.
Names: Sam Lee, a licensed acupuncturist, owns Lee Home Acupuncture LLC (the master's main company: home acupuncture and herbal consults, 500 Main St, leehomeacupuncture.com) and Lee Acupuncture Clinic LLC (the second company: the clinic, 60 Harbor St). Flow A's story is at the clinic; flow B's at Alex's home, 31 Linden Ave, where Alex can't drive for a few weeks.
People: Riley and Avery became Iris and Mia (acupuncturists at the clinic; only Iris does the child's visits). Jordan and Casey became Noah and Leo (home visits; only Noah does herbal consults, once his herbal certificate checks out). Lena, the master's form example, is Maya. Sam, Pat and Alex M. stay.
Kinds of work: plumbing became home acupuncture, electrical became herbal consults (it waits for the herbalist's certificate, where the state's form asks), the barbershop became the clinic. Licenses are each acupuncturist's own (a switch); a few states issue no acupuncture license, so the no-license branches (S1-60, S1-63, S2-28) stay as switches (splitsKept): registration only, and the national board certificate kept as the business's own word.
Prices: the master's numbers are kept as the example businesses' own prices, so every sum and fee stays right. Clinic: follow-up $35 (60 min), acupressure with no needles $40, cupping added $20, follow-up and cupping $55, child's visit $25, first visit $140 (90 min), a 5-visit package $160 sold at the clinic only. Home: home treatment $179 (60 min), first home visit $199 ($249 with Sam), home follow-up $150, the $89 trip fee, herbal consult $149. Fees: $20 at the clinic ($40 for the first visit), up to the $89 trip fee at home. They're examples, not a standard.
Money A: list|card|counter is the main path (a card saved only for the $20 fee, paid at the front desk by card, HSA card or cash). list|none|counter when a health plan or a work-injury or car-accident claim pays, or for a fee-free patient (the desk checks the plan, the share at the front desk). list|card|card for Saturday mornings, when Iris works alone with nobody at the desk (the saved card at DONE, as the old flowchart's 'the saved card with her OK'). Left out: holds, deposits, paid in full, Rosfield's bill, photos and visit pricing (every acupuncture price is on the list).
Money B: list|hold|bill is the main path (the $89 trip fee held, Rosie texts the bill at DONE). list|none|own when a plan or a claim pays (the business bills it). list|card|card when a card is saved and charged at DONE. Left out: deposits, paid in full, photos and visit pricing. The tip branch stays off (no tips for health visits).
Sign-up words follow these paths: S1-12/S1-13/S1-16/S1-17/S1-18 read back the home services (all $89 held, then the bill), S1-41/S1-42/S1-45 to S1-47 the clinic (card saved for the fee, at the front desk; Saturday mornings at DONE). No service is priced from photos or at the visit, so S11-08's quote OK is off, and S1-57 keeps bank transfer off.
No $2: the pilot's no-$2 sentences carry over with acupuncture's words (S1-26, S11-93, A9-21, B9-18, S11-63's screen, S11-64, S11-92).
Private texts: patient texts carry only the business, date, time, place, money and a link (pf.messages.never); clinic texts name no acupuncturist; home-visit texts keep Noah's name for the door check; owner and staff texts use initials (a build pass turns 'Alex M.' into 'A.M.' in visible owner and staff texts) and say only 'notes added' for health notes.
Own steps: A7-x01 and B7-x01, the acupuncturist reads the health update after booking, before the visit (the old flowchart's ac18); a change or a 'not right now' runs through A7-34 to A7-36 and B7-37 to B7-59, reworded for acupuncture (a call first, acupressure with no needles, or a free cancel).
Clocks: A main path Wed Oct 21 7:15pm booking, Thu Oct 22 9:00am read, Fri Oct 23 10:00am reminder, Sat Oct 24 11:00am check-in, 12:00pm done (60-minute follow-up), 12:05pm paid, 12:06pm receipt, 4:00pm rating. B: Mon Oct 19 6:40pm booking, Tue Oct 20 9:00am read, Wed Oct 21 10:00am reminder, Thu Oct 22 8:20am check-in, 9:25am DONE (60-minute home treatment), 9:27am bill, 9:30am receipt, 11:00am rating.
Off for acupuncture: walk-ins (A3-32 keeps 'No walk-ins'), the home branch and video at A4-01 and B4-01 (each company works in one place; no video visits), repeat plans (follow-ups are a series, A4-31 and B4-45), groups, held items, contracts (A5-19, B4-57), damage holds, crews, set dates, minimums, drop-offs, rentals, items left or taken, reports, proposals, warranties and free fixes, weather, lab orders, payer top amounts, extra work sold at the home, stages, bills for many visits, goods, pay over time, bank transfer, and the day-before hold at the clinic (no clinic service holds money).
Kept on: A4-43's first steps (on file, a doctor's referral the plan asks for, a reaction last time, the health forms), A7-61 (a stand-in, or nobody else for a child's visit) and A8-02, with acupuncture words.
Pilot words gone: a build pass maps the pilot's dental words in pairs no reader of this profession sees (hidden money paths) to neutral acupuncture words, and drops the pilot's ops on steps this profession never shows.
Not taken from the old flowchart: the 15-minute hold (the master's 10 minutes stays), the $50 fee (the master's $20 example), the 20-minute no-show mark (the master's 15), Medicare's details (kept as a switch: a plan that won't pay this business turns into self-pay with the notice), IntakeQ and the other outside software (outdated: Rosie is the software now), and Washington's health-data law applied everywhere (each state's own form instead).
Kept words: none.
Review, Oct 23: the no-reply stand-in never moves a patient (A7-21, B7-22: Sam calls; not reached by the visit, nobody is moved or sent; S11-46, S11-49 the same), as pf.staff.standIn and the old ac20o say. Iris's Saturday mornings with nobody at the desk are a setting Sam makes on the list|card|card path only: the main and plan paths' sign-up (S1-42) no longer sets them, S11-56 shows turning it on, and A9-01's Saturday-afternoon line shows only there. Off: A6-01's and B6-03's expert-read branches (the read comes after booking), A8-03's roster and drop-off branches, B9-19's plan share billed by Rosie.
Refit Oct 27 2026 (R13) to the REDESIGN 2 master: facts planbill, forms, firststeps, children, aftercare (the 5-visit package is sold at the clinic, outside booking: no packs fact); switch sensitive (health care: no rating); A set start times, B arrival windows, free cancel until 24 hours before. The $89 home trip fee is no longer held (D66): a card is saved for it as the late-cancel or nobody-home fee. Every legacy words op dropped; kept the own health-update steps (A7-x01, B7-x01), the more lines and the off ops on live branches; own words only on S1-13 (the money card, both flows). Kept words: 'leak' (a privacy leak), 'visit fee' (the master's rule for a price set at the visit).
